title: The Lock Call: Friday, November 27
blurb: The Farm Bureau prices Thanksgiving dinner at $58.63, Brett catches Merv at the top of the board, and Edwin blames an organ player.

lines.text: [bright] Dinner for ten cost fifty-eight sixty-three, and the bird did not cover.
[grinning] And I caught Merv. Eight picks. Go!
From The Window at Hardwood Bricks, this is Tops and Bottoms, the Lock Call. I'm Brett Busberger.
And I'm Leslie Phyllis, with the receipt. The Farm Bureau says Thanksgiving dinner for ten ran fifty-eight sixty-three. Up six percent. The turkey, up ten.
[wheezing] Somebody told me this was the cheap year.
[dry] Their economist blames diesel, and a shortage of farm labor. I wonder where the farm workers went, Edwin. That's one man's opinion.
Today's picks. The under, one forty-three, Texas Tech and San Diego State. And Vanderbilt, laying thirty-seven against Southern.
Thirty-seven, Merv? Bold. I have the over, one fifty-two, Bowling Green at Indiana. And Boise State, laying five and a half against Drake.
The machine likes two dogs. Saint Mary's, plus seven and a half against Texas. And Old Dominion, plus eighteen and a half at Virginia Tech.
[out of breath] Louisiana Tech, plus five at home against Texas State. And the under, one thirty-nine. The organ player at the ice rink is out sick. That's all I can say.
The board. I went two and oh yesterday. The house split again, four and four.
[grudging] So we're tied on top, young man. Ten, five and one apiece, up four point one units.
I'm third, ten and six. And Edwin is six and ten.
[proud] Three straight losses. That's a streak. Streaks go on the list.
That's the Lock Call. The picks column is up now at hardwood bricks dot com. Enjoy the leftovers.
Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: American Farm Bureau Federation, Nov 18, 2026: the classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 cost $58.63, "more than a 6% increase from 2025"; a 16-pound frozen turkey averaged $23.68, "up 10% from last year". AFBF deputy chief economist Faith Parum: "High diesel prices and a shortage of farm labor have taken a toll on the farm level of the food supply chain." Merv's aside about where the farm workers went is the gang's opinion and is said as one.

notes.board: Standings through Nov 26; yesterday = Nov 26 card (house 4-4, Brett 2-0).
